The project is built and committed. Here's a summary:

**ShipmentTracker** — Blazor Web App with **Auto interactivity** (Server → WebAssembly)

### Architecture decisions
| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side rendering on first visit |
| Snappy, no round-trips | WebAssembly takes over after download |
| Interactive controls on every page | `@rendermode InteractiveAuto` on all pages |
| Auth with individual accounts | ASP.NET Core Identity with roles |

### Pages
- **/** — Landing page with navigation cards
- **/track** — Public tracking by number (with progress bar)
- **/my-shipments** — Customer's shipments (auth required)
- **/dispatcher** — Full dashboard with filter, status updates, and shipment creation (Dispatcher role required)

### Demo accounts
- **Dispatcher:** `dispatcher@shipments.local` / `Dispatch1!`
- **Customer:** `customer@example.com` / `Customer1!`

Run with `cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker && dotnet run`.
